finalLens.pull_quote: I can keep doing it, but I cannot keep pretending this part helps.
finalLens.deeper_read: You notice it in the extra pass: the same small step creates more work than it saves. Once you begin, you tend to carry the whole sequence through, so naming what that step is for can make changing it feel possible.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you repeat a step even after it has created another pass.
finalLens.move: Before the next round, state what that step is meant to do and change its place once.

finalLens.move: Set a two-week trial with one clear result to check before you decide.
